biotools.summary: OmicSHIELD is an open-source platform enabling privacy-protected federated analysis of sensitive omics data, designed to support various biomedical research analyses like GWAS and transcriptomics. It facilitates collaborative studies while maintaining data privacy and complies with regulatory requirements.
